clips.title: The story
paras: The Applejack Still is a distillation apparatus used to process fermented apples into high-proof liquor. Approaching the device reveals a stinging vapor of concentrated fruit, which the machine condenses and dispenses as a clear spirit.

The Applejack Still is a functional distillation device constructed to refine fermented cider into high-proof spirits. Anyone stepping close to the apparatus is immediately greeted by a pungent aroma of concentrated apples sharp enough to sting the nostrils. Its piping and condensing coils efficiently extract and concentrate the essence of the orchard harvest into potent liquor.

Once activated and allowed to run its course, the machine condenses the vaporized alcohol into a clear, purified spirit. The finished applejack dispenses neatly into a waiting bottle at the outlet, ready for consumption or storage. Despite the rough-and-ready nature of field distilling, the apparatus reliably produces a clear and potent brew.
